common_conditions.measurement_plane: IN/OFFSET_TIP and OUT_TIP relative to declared source/receiver grounds; record meter uncertainty, source Thevenin impedance and actual load impedance
common_conditions.rails: Record actual positive/negative rails, reference and ground shifts; no new tolerance
common_conditions.range: Only unclipped states within verified headroom for accuracy; overload characterization separate
common_conditions.temperature: Proposed25C characterization point, not a newly adopted service condition or tolerance
common_conditions.warmup: 20 minutes from canonical standard; record actual stabilization

calibrated_path.allowed_adjustments: No adjustment performed or authorized here. Factoryprocedure must identify real permissible actuators, sequence,range,persistence and independent verification points. Existingfrontcontrols are not assumed independentgain trims; no numerical subtraction/fitting counts as physicalcalibration
calibrated_path.held_controls: Record desiredgain/manualoffset and exact control positions; once permittedfactoryadjustment is completed, lock settings across verification sweep; usercontrol changes require separately defined acceptance states
calibrated_path.load: Propose10kohm static acceptance load, explicitly unadopted; finalfactoryprotocol must specify load
calibrated_path.metric: Compare actual output after approvedfactoryprocedure with approved targettransfer; retain2mV canonical static target. No postcal residual available
calibrated_path.reference: Independent calibrated external sources/meter and specified desiredmanualoffset; no nominal pot endpoint or on-board reference treated as perfect
calibrated_path.stimulus: Propose externalCV sweep and IN centre/±1 endpoints, manualmid/endpoints and selected mixed states, all unclipped; final acceptance grid must be approved

fixed_setting.allowed_adjustments: None during a state; moving to another declared state is setup, not calibration
fixed_setting.held_controls: Lock recorded ATTEN/OFFSET per state; rails, temperature, reference and load fixed during readings
fixed_setting.load: Propose10kohm atOUT_TIP with instrument loading recorded; historical resistor-only values exclude output stage
fixed_setting.metric: Uncalibrated fixed-setting residual; historical16.475227mV max and6.00105mV manualendpoint sensitivity are not postcal acceptance bounds
fixed_setting.reference: Ideal electrical-fraction law (2a-1)*IN+CV+5*(2x-1), using measured external inputs; nominal5V manual reference is a diagnostic assumption
fixed_setting.stimulus: Retain ten historical states at recorded electrical a/x fractions; include manual endpoints with IN=CV=0

paired_CV.allowed_adjustments: None within sweep; difference or fitted slope is diagnostic only, no output correction or calibration coefficients applied
paired_CV.held_controls: Set and record ATTEN/OFFSET once; no changes across paired readings; actual reference/rails/temp and load unchanged
paired_CV.load: Propose10kohm fixed throughout slope/intercept measurement; no mixing open andloaded points
paired_CV.metric: Gain=(OUT(+5)−OUT(−5))/(CV(+5)−CV(−5)); report intercept/OUT0 and each raw residual separately. Constant intercept cancels only to extent stable; pairedspan error not a2mV absolute acceptance test
paired_CV.reference: Independent traceable external voltage readings, not on-boardREF5 or nominal pot fraction; record OUT0 separately
paired_CV.stimulus: IN=0; external OFFSET_CV sweep−5,0,+5V measured atjack, using same source impedance

same_setting_load.allowed_adjustments: None between paired loads; do not rezero or change stimulus to restore target output after load changes
same_setting_load.held_controls: Hold inputs, ATTEN/OFFSET, calibrationstate, rails/temp/reference and groundconnection unchanged within each pair; record settling
same_setting_load.load: Open→10kohm ascanonical; record actual resistance and instrument loading
same_setting_load.metric: OUT10k−OUTopen at same setting; retain distinct1mV target, not summed into or replaced by calibrated2mV target
same_setting_load.reference: Same external meter/referenceplane for both readings; open means documented instrument load
same_setting_load.stimulus: Establish nominal−5,0,+5V output test states using declared input/control setup, then alternate open and10kohm atOUT_TIP
